summary: 17-year-old asthmatic male from California jumped from a four-wheeler in Slaughterhouse Gulch near Bailey and disappeared; a SARDOC dog searched two hours through thick woods in heavy fog, trailing and air-scenting to the subject and making the find from long distance.
notes: Date Saturday-verified. Subject reportedly saw a 'chicken' and jumped out of the truck with his pellet gun; dog made weak voice contact then the find.
